chapterInfo.content:
21
Dawid kɔ Nob ne Gat
1Na Dawid baa Nob Ɔsɔfoɔ Ahimelek nkyɛn. Na Ahimelek de ahopopoɔ bɛhyiaa Dawid, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Adɛn nti na wo nko ara wonam na onipa biara nka wo ho yi? 2Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Ɔsɔfoɔ Ahimelek sɛ: Ɔhene ahyɛ me asɛm bi die, na waka akyerɛ me sɛ: Mma obiara nnhunu adekodeɛ a meresoma wo ho ne deɛ mahyɛ woɔ no ho biribiara; na mmeranteɛ no nso, mahyɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnkɔ baabi. 3Na afei, ɛdeɛn na ɛwɔ wo nsam? Ma me paanoo nnum anaa biribiara a wobɛnya. 4#Lew 24.5-9; 22.3-7; Eks 19.15 Na ɔsɔfoɔ no buaa Dawid sɛ: Paanoo hunu biara nni me nsam, sɛ paanoo kronkron na ɛwɔ hɔ; sɛ mmeranteɛ no akora wɔn ho afiri mmaa ho nko a! 5Na Dawid buaa see ɔsɔfoɔ no sɛ: Ampa, wɔmma mmaa mmɛn yɛn berɛ biara a yɛrekɔ akɔdi dwuma bi no; na mmeranteɛ no adeɛ ho te, na nkantom nnɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn adeɛ ho teɛ yi. 6#Mat 12.3 Ɛnna ɔsɔfoɔ no de akronkronneɛ no maa no, ɛfiri sɛ na paanoo biara nni hɔ sɛ Kyerɛ paanoo a wɔyi firi AWURADE anim de paanoohyeɛ bɛgu hɔ da a wɔyiiɛ no.
7 # 1 Sa 22.9, 18 Nso na Saulo nkoa mu nipa bi wɔ hɔ da no, a wɔato no mu AWURADE anim, ne din de Doeg, Edomni a ɔyɛ Saulo mmoahwɛfoɔ mu panin.
8Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Ahimelek sɛ: Pea anaa nkrantɛ biara nni wo nsam ha? Na me nkrantɛ ne me nnoɔma mpo mamfa mankura, ɛfiri sɛ ɔhene asɛm no, wɔpɛ no ntɛm. 9#1 Sa 17.50-51 Na ɔsɔfoɔ no kaa sɛ: Filistini Goliat a wokum no Ela bonhwa mu no nkrantɛ, hwɛ, ɛno na wɔabobɔ no ntoma mu da asɔfotadeɛ no akyire no, ɛno na wobɛfa a, fa, na foforɔ biara nni ha sɛ ɛno. Na Dawid kaa sɛ: Ebi nte sɛ ɛno, fa ma me!
10 # Dwom 56.1 Na Dawid sɔre dwanee da no Saulo anim, na ɔkɔɔ Gathene Akis nkyɛn. 11#1 Sa 18.7; 29.5 Na Akis nkoa ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Ɛnyɛ Dawid, asase no so hene no nie? Ɛnyɛ oyi na wɔtoo ne ho dwom asa mu kaa sɛ:
Saulo akum n’apem,
na Dawid akum ne mpem du no?
12Na Dawid de nsɛm yi siee n’akoma mu, na ɔsuroo Gat hene Akis anim sɛ. 13#Dwom 34.1 Na ɔsakyeraa ne suban wɔn anim, na ɔboapa yɛɛ ne ho bɔdamfoɔ wɔn nsam, na ɔwerɛwerɛɛ kuro no apono nta ho, na ɔmaa ne ntasuo sinsianee n’abɔgyesɛ mu. 14Ɛnna Akis ka kyerɛɛ ne nkoa sɛ: Hwɛ, mohunu sɛ onipa yi abɔ dam, na adɛn nti na mode no abrɛ me? 15Abɔdamfoɔ abɔ me na mode oyi aba sɛ ɔmmɛdi me so abɔdansɛm yi? Oyi mmra me fie anaa?

Na ɔsakyeraa ne suban wɔn anim, na ɔboapa yɛɛ ne ho bɔdamfoɔ wɔn nsam, na ɔwerɛwerɛɛ kuro no apono nta ho, na ɔmaa ne ntasuo sinsianee n’abɔgyesɛ mu. Ɛnna Akis ka kyerɛɛ ne nkoa sɛ: Hwɛ, mohunu sɛ onipa yi abɔ dam, na adɛn nti na mode no abrɛ me? Abɔdamfoɔ abɔ me na mode oyi aba sɛ ɔmmɛdi me so abɔdansɛm yi? Oyi mmra me fie anaa?

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
